renewal_options: IOSH Managing Safely certificates are valid for 3 years. Refresher courses are available and recommended before expiry. Full recertification requires retaking the test and submitting a new project.

official_study_resources.title: IOSH Managing Safely Course Materials
official_study_resources.notes: Course materials provided by the IOSH-licensed training provider as part of the course fee.

lifecycle.summary: IOSH still sells Working Safely through its approved-provider network: the course page gives 'Course details Duration – One day Cost – Varies by training provider' and 'Certification – Successful delegates receive an IOSH Working Safely certificate, which you can verify online with IOSH', with '270,000 certificates issued since 2020'. No retirement or withdrawal wording appears anywhere on the page.
